map.如何使用图像分类识别？: How do I use Image Classification?
map.图像分类识别适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Image Classification best for?
map.基于 Transformers.js 在浏览器本地运行 ViT 模型，识别图像中: Runs a ViT model locally in the browser via Transformers.js to recognize objects / scenes in images, with no data upload.
map.本工具在浏览器本地加载图像分类模型，对上传图片推理并返回置信度最高的前 5 个类: This tool loads an image-classification model locally in the browser, runs inference on the uploaded image and returns the top 5 classes by confidence, all without upload.
map.在浏览器本地用预训练模型(如 MobileNet)对上传图片推理，输出 Top5: Run a pretrained model (e.g. MobileNet) locally in the browser on the uploaded image and output the Top-5 classes with probabilities.
map.纯前端运行，图片不上传，保护隐私且离线可用，适合轻量识别与演示。: Runs fully client-side with no upload, protecting privacy and working offline, suited to lightweight recognition and demos.
map.模型精度有限且对对抗样本敏感，结果仅供辅助，关键场景需人工确认。: Model accuracy is limited and sensitive to adversarial examples; results are for assistance only, and critical cases need human confirmation.
map.上传一张猫的照片，模型返回 Top5：['Egyptian cat' 0.82,: Upload a photo of a cat; the model returns Top-5: ['Egyptian cat' 0.82,'tabby' 0.10,...]. High probability is not absolute; confusable classes (e.g. cat breeds) need contextual judgment.
map.预训练模型覆盖有限、对角度/光照/背景敏感，且可能受对抗扰动影响；纯前端轻量模型: Pretrained models have limited coverage and are sensitive to angle/lighting/background, and may be affected by adversarial perturbations; lightweight client-side models are less accurate than cloud LLMs, so important judgments need review.
map.不会。本工具在浏览器内完成推理，图片不离开设备；但仅本地也意味着无法调用更强的云: No. Inference runs entirely inside the browser and the image never leaves the device; but being local-only also means no stronger cloud model can be used.
